summary_en: The study tests TTI-101 alone and combined with other drugs in hepatocellular carcinoma, a type of liver cancer that is locally advanced or metastatic and cannot be removed by surgery. TTI-101 is taken as an oral tablet, and pembrolizumab, atezolizumab, or bevacizumab is given by intravenous (IV) infusion in the combination groups; how often and for how long is not stated. The main outcome is safety and tolerability, with the phase 1b part also finding the maximum tolerated dose or recommended phase 2 dose, and the phase 2 part also assessing preliminary efficacy.
summary_es: El estudio evalúa TTI-101 solo y combinado con otros medicamentos en el carcinoma hepatocelular, un tipo de cáncer de hígado que es localmente avanzado o metastásico y no puede extirparse con cirugía. TTI-101 se toma como tableta oral, y pembrolizumab, atezolizumab o bevacizumab se administran por infusión intravenosa (IV) en los grupos de combinación; la frecuencia y la duración no se indican. El resultado principal es la seguridad y la tolerabilidad, y en la fase 1b también se busca la dosis máxima tolerada o la dosis recomendada para la fase 2; la fase 2 además evalúa la eficacia preliminar.
who_for: Adults 18 years or older who can give informed consent.
Locally advanced, metastatic, or unresectable hepatocellular carcinoma with measurable disease.
ECOG performance status of 0 or 1 and Child-Pugh class A or B7.
Cohort A: progression on up to 3 prior lines of systemic therapy.
Cohort B: progression after at least 2 cycles of first-line anti-PD-1 or anti-PD-L1 therapy. Cohort C: no prior systemic treatment for this cancer.
not_for: Known fibrolamellar, sarcomatoid, or mixed cholangiocarcinoma and HCC.
Prior treatment of this cancer with a STAT inhibitor.
History of hepatic encephalopathy or stroke within the previous 2 years.
Significant heart problems, or left ventricular ejection fraction below 50%.
